mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT j.MEDICAL_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE , CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER , TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PRESCRIPTION_DATE , nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY j.MEDICAL_NUMBER) AS MED_CNT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.MEDICAL_NUMBER ORDER BY j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME) AS RN FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION j JOIN MEDICINE mc ON j.MEDICINE_CODE = mc.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = mc.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r ON j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE j.INJECTED_YN = 'N' ) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY PRESCRIPTION_DATE ASC

SELECT j.MEDICAL_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE , CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER , TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PRESCRIPTION_DATE , nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , j.DOSAGE , unitCode.CODENAME_1 AS UNIT , J.FREQUENCY , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS DOCTOR_NAME , mr.DIAGNOSIS_NAME FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION j JOIN MEDICINE mc ON j.MEDICINE_CODE = mc.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = mc.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' JOIN COMMONCODE unitCode ON unitCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = j.UNIT AND unitCode.COMMONCODE = 'U' JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r ON j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN MEMBER doc ON r.DOCTOR_NUMBER = doc.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN MEDICAL_RECORD mr ON r.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = mr.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT j.MEDICAL_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE , CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)), 2) = 1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER , TO_CHAR(j.INJECTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS INJECTION_DATE , nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY j.MEDICAL_NUMBER) AS MED_CNT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.MEDICAL_NUMBER ORDER BY j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME) AS RN FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION j JOIN MEDICINE mc ON j.MEDICINE_CODE = mc.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = mc.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r ON j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER WHERE j.INJECTED_YN = 'Y'
AND j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
AND j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') + 1
AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'HH24')) >= 9 AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'HH24')) < 13
AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'HH24')) >= 13 AND TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(j.INJECTION_ORDER_TIME, 'HH24')) < 18
AND (m.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
) WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY INJECTION_DATE DESC

SELECT j.MEDICAL_NUMBER , m.MEMBER_NAME , SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 6) AS BIRTH_DATE , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1900 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (2000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 1, 2))) ELSE 0 END AS AGE , CASE WHEN MOD(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(m.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, 7, 1)),2) =1 THEN '남' ELSE '여' END AS GENDER , TO_CHAR(j.INJECTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS INJECTION_DATE , nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , j.DOSAGE , unitCode.CODENAME_1 AS UNIT , j.FREQUENCY , doc.MEMBER_NAME AS DOCTOR_NAME , mr.DIAGNOSIS_NAME FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION j JOIN MEDICINE mc ON j.MEDICINE_CODE = mc.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = mc.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' JOIN COMMONCODE unitCode ON unitCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = j.UNIT AND unitCode.COMMONCODE = 'U' JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER r ON j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = r.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_NUMBER = m.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN MEMBER doc ON r.DOCTOR_NUMBER = doc.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN MEDICAL_RECORD mr ON r.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = mr.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER WHERE j.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND j.INJECTED_YN = 'Y'

SELECT nameCode.CODENAME_1 AS MEDICINE_NAME , d.TOTAL_QTY , d.FREQUENCY , TO_CHAR(d.PRESCRIPTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PRESCRIPTION_DATE , d.NUMBER_OF_DAYS_ADMINISTERED , CASE WHEN d.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'Y' THEN '조제완료' WHEN d.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N' THEN '조제대기' ELSE d.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS END AS PRESCRIPTION_STATUS FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION d JOIN MEDICINE mc ON d.MEDICINE_CODE = mc.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE nameCode ON nameCode.COMMONCODE_NUMBER = mc.MEDICINE_NAME AND nameCode.COMMONCODE = 'M' WHERE d.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} ORDER BY d.PRESCRIPTION_DATE ASC

SELECT TREATMENT_ITEM_NAME , THERAPY_TYPE , CASE WHEN TREATMENT_STATUS = '대기' THEN '치료대기' WHEN TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료중' THEN '치료중' WHEN TREATMENT_STATUS = '치료완료' THEN '치료완료' ELSE TREATMENT_STATUS END AS TREATMENT_STATUS , TO_CHAR(DATE_OF_TREATMENT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS DATE_OF_TREATMENT , TO_CHAR(TREATMENT_START_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS TREATMENT_START_TIME , TO_CHAR(TREATMENT_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS TREATMENT_END_TIME FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} ORDER BY DATE_OF_TREATMENT ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OUTPATIENTNURSE_INJECTION WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND INJECTED_YN = 'N') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PHYSICALTHERAPIST_RECORDS WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND TREATMENT_STATUS <> '치료완료') FROM DUAL
